info.author: Augusto de Lelis Araujo and Renan da Paixao Maciel
info.name: vasprocar
info.summary: VASProcar is an open-source package written in the Python 3 programming language, which aims to provide an intuitive tool for the post-processing of the output files produced by the DFT VASP code, through an interactive user interface.
